channels.setupGuide: How to get this — step by step
channels.webhookSetupNote: Finish setup in the Meta dashboard: open your app → Webhooks, paste the callback URL and verify token below, then subscribe to the messages and messaging fields (Instagram: also comments).
channels.fieldBotTokenPh: Paste the token from the bot provider

TELEGRAM: Choose a name and a username for your bot.
Copy the token BotFather gives you and paste it below.
BALE: Open @botfather in Bale and create a new bot.
Pick a name and username for your bot.
Copy the issued token and paste it below.
RUBIKA: Open the BotFather bot inside Rubika and create a new bot.
Set a name and username, then copy the API token.
Paste the token below. We register the receive-update endpoint automatically.
WHATSAPP: Create a Meta app at developers.facebook.com and add the WhatsApp product.
In WhatsApp → API Setup, copy the Phone number ID.
Generate a permanent access token (via a System User with whatsapp_business_messaging permission).
Paste the access token and phone number ID below and connect.
After connecting, copy the callback URL and verify token shown here into WhatsApp → Configuration → Webhook, and subscribe to the messages field.
INSTAGRAM: Convert your Instagram account to a Professional (Business or Creator) account: Instagram app → Settings → Account type and tools → Switch to Professional Account.
Link the Instagram account to a Facebook Page: Instagram app → Settings → Business/Creator → Connect a Facebook Page.
Open Graph API Explorer: developers.facebook.com/tools/explorer/ — select your app.
Select these permissions: pages_show_list, pages_read_engagement, pages_messaging, instagram_basic, instagram_manage_messages, instagram_manage_comments.
Click "Generate Access Token", log in with Facebook, and Accept all permissions.
Copy the token (prefixed EAA…) and paste it below. We automatically derive the correct Page Access Token from it.
After connecting, copy the callback URL and verify token into your Meta app's Webhooks, and subscribe to the messages and comments fields.

Important — Development mode: until your app is published, only app admins/developers/testers can send messages that trigger webhooks. To test from another account: App Roles → Instagram Testers → add the test account; they must accept the invitation in their Instagram app (Settings → Business → Invitations).

items.q: Do I need technical skills to use it?
items.a: No. Vigent is built for business owners, not developers. Create an agent in a few clicks, upload your data, and connect the channel you want.
Under 5 minutes. Pick a ready-made template, upload your catalog or documents, and add your first connection — the agent starts answering immediately.

items.q: How are AI token costs handled?
items.a: You bring your own OpenRouter key, and token costs are billed directly and transparently to your account. Vigent only charges for the platform — no middleman, no markup.
Telegram, WhatsApp, Instagram, Rubika, Bale and a web widget. For WordPress sites there's an official plugin that syncs your WooCommerce products automatically.

items.q: What happens when the agent doesn't know an answer?
items.a: It hands the conversation off to a human operator and records the question in the learning center — one approval from you and it answers on its own next time.
Yes. Your data is used only to power your own agent, is never shared, and you can delete it whenever you want.

items.q: How well does the agent understand Persian?
items.a: Vigent is built and optimized for Persian — from casual to formal, even Persian voice notes. English is fully supported too.

items.q: Can I try it for free?
items.a: Yes — a 14-day free trial with every feature, no credit card required. Upgrade whenever you're ready.
